title: Next Retail Supplier Cyber Incident
description: Next warned that hackers gained access to limited data through a technology supplier. Customer personal data not compromised; information described as limited and benign.
impact: Supplier environment affected; company systems intact.

title: Samsung Securities Customer Data Exposure
description: Cyberattack exposed personal information of 8,241 customers including names, account numbers and driver's licence numbers from complaint form attachments.
impact: Personal and financial data of over 8,000 customers exposed.

title: Cleverbridge Payment Card Data Breach
description: E-commerce platform confirmed third-party access to stored payment card data including card numbers and CVVs after a November 4 intrusion. Serves clients including Red Hat, Sony, SUSE, Veeam.
impact: Payment card data of customers exposed; risk of fraud.
source: Company confirmation, Help Net Security, Bloomberg

title: KEPCO Customer Platform Breach
description: South Korea's state electricity company confirmed attackers took personal data from KEPCO ON customer platform and e-procurement system, including resident registration, bank account and card numbers.
impact: Personal and financial data of electricity customers exposed.

title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Bank Heist
description: Attackers compromised a third-party service provider and transferred approximately €100 million (up to €118M) using the bank's own account, later converted to cryptocurrency. Customer funds not affected.
impact: Significant financial loss to the bank.

title: JPMorgan, Visa, Mastercard Vendor Data Exposure
description: n0n ransomware group claimed attack on Qubole vendor. Customer names and emails for JPMorgan Chase, Visa, and Mastercard cardholders leaked.
impact: Data exposure for phishing.

title: Equinor Cyberattack
description: Cyberattack against IT systems detected Nov 17 and stopped by Nov 20. No impact on oil/gas production; no evidence of data theft.
impact: IT disruption only; operations unaffected.

title: Binance Hot Wallet Theft
description: Attackers drained approximately $6.3 billion from Binance hot wallets across multiple blockchains in about 20 minutes. Compromised engineer workstation suspected.
impact: Massive cryptocurrency theft; partial freezes by Tether and Circle.

title: IDCF Cloud Ransomware Attack
description: Ransomware took down SoftBank subsidiary IDC Frontier's IDCF Cloud East Japan region, affecting 495 companies and local governments. Attacker claimed encryption of 225 databases (3.6 PB).
impact: Widespread cloud service disruption for hundreds of organizations.

title: Capcom ID Data Breach
description: Unauthorized access to CAPCOM ID membership service exposed more than 11.7 million customer email addresses and account metadata. 196 accounts had passwords changed without authorization.
impact: Large-scale email and account data exposure.

title: CenterPoint Energy Data Theft
description: US utility confirmed attacker obtained customer personal information via external-facing API lacking rate limiting. Claims of 7.49 million records including names, addresses, SSNs, and driver's licenses. Over 1 million Texans affected.
impact: Large-scale utility customer data exposure.
source: SEC filing, Texas AG notice, SOCRadar

title: Denmark CPR Register Breach
description: Someone misused a private company's lawful lookup access to Denmark's Central Person Register, exposing personal information of 8.8 million registered citizens.
impact: National identity register data exposure.

title: Bitget Cryptocurrency Hack
description: Attackers drained roughly $388 million from Bitget hot and warm wallets via a zero-day in third-party security products. Attackers planted web shells and moved laterally to wallet servers.
impact: Major cryptocurrency theft.

title: Pentagon DMDC Personnel Data Breach
description: Data breach at the Defense Manpower Data Center affected over 3 million people. Personnel records for Department of Defense maintained by the agency were exposed.
impact: Defense personnel data of millions exposed.

title: French Supermarket Refrigeration Attack
description: Attackers logged into refrigeration controllers at up to 700 French supermarkets (Intermarché, Netto, Carrefour, etc.) and switched them to defrost, disrupting cold chain.
impact: Operational disruption to retail cold storage.

title: SafePay Ransomware Critical Infrastructure Campaign
description: CISA, FBI and partners warned that SafePay ransomware has compromised at least 600 critical infrastructure organizations across North America, South America, Europe and Australia since August 2024. Uses credential abuse, VPN exploitation, and double-extortion.
impact: Hundreds of critical infrastructure victims.

title: Polymarket Wallet Drain
description: Third-party script on Polymarket's platform drained wallets of logged-in traders, with estimates of $2.5-2.7 million stolen. Platform entered cancel-only mode.
impact: Trader funds stolen via supply-chain script.

title: GMO Onamae Desktop Cloud Ransomware Threat
description: Attackers accessed infrastructure behind Onamae.com Desktop Cloud and planted malware on up to 26,739 customer servers. GMO urged customers to shut down systems amid ransomware threat.
impact: Mass malware deployment on customer servers.

title: Keio Railway Ransomware Attack
description: Ransomware attack on Japanese railway company Keio. Rail operations unaffected, but some sales systems of subsidiary companies experienced problems. Network isolation implemented.
impact: Limited operational disruption to rail subsidiary systems.

title: State Bank of India Customer Records Leak
description: Preliminary review of alleged dark web leak found 3,897 customer records with names, mobile numbers, dates of birth, addresses, CIF numbers and loan details. Core banking not affected.
impact: Limited customer personal and loan data exposure.
